q-141873.name: Question 1
q-141873.worked_solution:
First, we distribute the $(-4)$ over each of the terms in parentheses.

$$
\begin{aligned}\begin{aligned}2u+(5u+v)\cdot (-4) & = \\ 2u+5u\cdot (-4)+v\cdot (-4) & = \\ 2u+(-20u)+(-4v) & = \\ 2u-20u-4v & .\end{aligned}\end{aligned}
$$

Then, we collect like terms.

 

$$
\begin{aligned}2u-20u-4v & = \\ (2u-20u)-4v & = \\ -18u-4v & \end{aligned}
$$

?

a
−16u−4v
b
18u−4v
c
16u−4v
d
−18u−4v
e
−16u+4v
Submit
Correct
EXPLANATION

First, we distribute the (−4) over each of the terms in parentheses.

2u+(5u+v)⋅(−4)=2u+5u⋅(−4)+v⋅(−4)=2u+(−20u)+(−4v)=2u−20u−4v.

Then, we collect like terms.

2u−20u−4v=(2u−20u)−4v=−18u−4v

q-141910.name: Question 2
q-141910.worked_solution:
First, we distribute the $(-2)$ over each of the terms in parentheses.

$$
\begin{aligned}\begin{aligned}(-2)(3x+y)+8y & = \\ (-2)\cdot 3x+(-2)\cdot y+8y & = \\ (-6x)+(-2y)+8y & = \\ -6x-2y+8y & \end{aligned}\end{aligned}
$$

Then, we collect like terms.

$$
\begin{aligned}\begin{aligned}-6x-2y+8y & = \\ -6x+(8y-2y) & = \\ -6x+6y & \end{aligned}\end{aligned}
$$

q-141938.name: Question 3
q-141938.worked_solution:
First, we distribute the $4$ over each of the terms in parentheses.

$$
\begin{aligned}4(2-a)+12 & = \\ 4\cdot 2+4\cdot (-a)+12 & = \\ (8)+(-4a)+12 & = \\ 8-4a+12\end{aligned}
$$

Then, we collect like terms.

$$
\begin{aligned}8-4a+12 & = \\ (8+12)-4a & = \\ 20-4a\end{aligned}
$$

Question 3
?

Simplify 4(2−a)+12.

a
4−4a
b
20−4a
c
8−4a
d
8−a
e
20−a
Submit
Correct
EXPLANATION

First, we distribute the 4 over each of the terms in parentheses.

4(2−a)+12=4⋅2+4⋅(−a)+12=(8)+(−4a)+12=8−4a+12

Then, we collect like terms.

8−4a+12=(8+12)−4a=20−4a

q-173697.name: Question 4
q-173697.worked_solution:
First, we distribute the $2$ over each of the terms in parentheses.

$$
\begin{aligned}12-3x+(4x-5)\cdot 2 & = \\ 12-3x+4x\cdot 2+(-5)\cdot 2 & = \\ 12-3x+(8x)+(-10) & = \\ 12-3x+8x-10\end{aligned}
$$

Then, we collect like terms.

$$
\begin{aligned}12-3x+8x-10 & = \\ (12-10)+(-3x+8x) & = \\ (2)+(5x) & = \\ 2+5x\end{aligned}
$$
